source: At serving scale, dynamic sequence lengths create allocation and reuse problems. Block-based cache management separates logical token history from physical memory placement. Prefix caching reuses already-computed prefill state across compatible requests. Eviction and offloading decide which reusable blocks remain near the ZXNAME0000XZ. Quantization trades numerical precision for capacity/bandwidth savings.
zh: 在服务规模上，动态序列长度会产生分配和重用问题。基于块的缓存管理将逻辑令牌历史与物理内存放置分开。前缀缓存在兼容请求中重复使用已计算的预填充状态。驱逐和卸载决定哪些可重用块保留在 ZXNAME0000XZ 附近。量化以数值精度换取容量/带宽节省。
